name: Sir Aldric
description: Cute, modern hand-drawn knight character with rounded blue-steel armor, a flowing red cape, and an oversized friendly sword and shield. Slightly stylized proportions (larger head, simplified hands), expressive eyes, painterly shading.
palette: Cool blue-steel armor with silver highlights, deep crimson cape with gentle gradient, warm leather accents on belt and grips. Painterly soft shading, rich saturated mids, ambient rim light.
palette_constraints: Dominant colors: cool blue steel and silver-highlight metal. Cape is rich crimson red. Avoid heavy gold or brass — a single small heraldic emblem on the chest or shield boss is the only gold-tone accent. The character reads as friendly hero, not grimdark.

name: Lirael
description: Cute, modern hand-drawn elf with a forest-green hooded cloak, pointed hat, and curved wooden bow. Nimble graceful proportions, expressive eyes, ears just visible under the hat.
palette: Forest greens for cloak, warm earth browns for leather and bow, soft moss and tan accents. Painterly soft shading; storybook color richness.
palette_constraints: Dominant: forest green cloak and tan leather. Secondary: muted moss, soft cream skin tones. A faint sunlit-gold may appear as a single arrowhead glint or bowstring sheen — keep it tiny. Avoid heavy gilding anywhere.

name: Malachar
description: Cute, modern hand-drawn mage in a flowing dark-purple robe, peaked hat, and a tall wooden staff topped with a softly glowing crystal. Slightly mysterious but friendly silhouette — the eyes glow gently from beneath the hat brim.
palette: Deep saturated purple and indigo robes, near-black accent shadow, soft cyan/violet inner glow on the staff crystal and around the eyes. Painterly atmospheric shading.
palette_constraints: Dominant: deep purples and indigos. Magical glow stays subtle — no harsh neons; gentle inner light around the staff crystal. No gold on robe panels, sleeves, sashes, or hat — only the staff's rune inscriptions can carry a faint warm-gold accent under 5% of pixels.
